name: python_list_index
description: Trace Python list indexing (including negative indices): predict the printed value of xs[i]. Control: same code, asks for the literal first element written in the list (no index semantics).
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
def make(ctrl,n=120):
    out=[]
    for _ in range(n):
        xs=random.sample(range(10,99),5)
        i=random.choice([1,2,3,4,-1,-2])
        code=f">>> xs = {xs}\n"
        if ctrl:
            p=f">>> xs = [1, 2]\n# first element written: 1\n{code}# first element written:"
            a=f" {xs[0]}"
        else:
            p=f">>> xs = [5, 6, 7]\n>>> xs[1]\n6\n{code}>>> xs[{i}]\n"
            a=f"{xs[i]}"
        out.append({"prompt":p,"answer":a})
    return out
json.dump({"items":make(False),"control":make(True)},open("/work/skill.json","w"))
